taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.culm_length_m.note: FEIS's bluebunch wheatgrass review (Zlatnik 1999, read 2026-10-15): "a native, cool-season, perennial grass with densely tufted culms, 12-30 in. (30-100 cm) tall".

traits.life_span.note: FEIS's bluebunch wheatgrass review (Zlatnik 1999, read 2026-10-15): "perennial grass".

traits.inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read names the awns but not the spike; wheatgrass spikelets sit singly on the rachis.

traits.awns.note: FEIS's bluebunch wheatgrass review (Zlatnik 1999, read 2026-10-15): the typical subspecies has "divergent awns".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: FEIS's bluebunch wheatgrass review (Zlatnik 1999, read 2026-10-15): densely tufted; it only "occasionally produces short rhizomes in more mesic environments".

traits.clonal.note: FEIS's bluebunch wheatgrass review (Zlatnik 1999, read 2026-10-15): it "regenerates by tillering" and from seed, a bunchgrass.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Hitchcock (1935) p. 240, no. 18, Agropyron spicatum (bluebunch wheatgrass): "blades flat to loosely involute, 1 to 2 mm, sometimes to 4 mm wide".

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS's bluebunch wheatgrass review (Zlatnik 1999, read 2026-10-16), central Utah: "seed ripe" July 17, disseminating July 23, disseminated August 6; read as July and August.

generator.params.note: Blue wildrye's values, changed by hand for bluebunch wheatgrass: a dense tuft of narrower blades and slender spikes of single spikelets, flowering in only some years (FEIS, Zlatnik 1999: "The plants do not flower and produce seeds every year"). The culm height comes from the stated culm length by the rule. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 70 cm at 4 years, within FEIS's 30-100 cm culms (Zlatnik 1999). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: blue-green blades; pale spikes.

traits.awn_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935) p. 240, no. 18, Agropyron spicatum (bluebunch wheatgrass): "lemmas about 1 cm long, the awn strongly divergent, 1 to 2 cm long".

traits.awn_insertion.note: Hitchcock (1935) p. 240, no. 18, Agropyron spicatum (bluebunch wheatgrass): the lemma ends in its awn ("lemmas about 1 cm long, the awn strongly divergent").

traits.florets_per_spikelet.note: Hitchcock (1935) p. 240, no. 18, Agropyron spicatum (bluebunch wheatgrass): spikelets "mostly 6- to 8-flowered".

traits.spikelet_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935) p. 240, no. 18, Agropyron spicatum: the rachis internodes "1 to 2 cm long, or the lowermost 2.5 cm", the spikelets "not as long (excluding the awns) as the internodes or slightly longer", read as 1.2 to 2 cm; Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, Agropyron no. 12) gives lemmas 12-15 mm.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L438370), as no source read gives it.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L438370), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L438370), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L438370), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L438370), as no source read gives it.
